status_value_definitions.proposed: guardrail is proposed but not implemented.
status_value_definitions.deferred: guardrail is explicitly deferred to a later phase.
status_value_definitions.soft_check: guardrail is implemented as a soft check only (e.g., a manual review checklist, not a CI test).

implemented_structural_guardrails.name: no direct sqlite3 / sqlalchemy imports outside app/persistence/*
implemented_structural_guardrails.enforcement_scope: all files outside app/persistence/* must not import sqlite3 or sqlalchemy directly.

implemented_structural_guardrails.name: no service imports main_web or main_api
implemented_structural_guardrails.enforcement_scope: no service imports in main_web.py or main_api.py; complements the existing 51F guardrail.

implemented_structural_guardrails.name: no sqlite3.Connection or sqlite3.connect instantiation outside app/persistence/*
implemented_structural_guardrails.enforcement_scope: no sqlite3.Connection or sqlite3.connect instantiation outside app/persistence/*.

implemented_structural_guardrails.name: no service or route imports get_cursor directly
implemented_structural_guardrails.false_positive_risk: low (would only trigger on unusual variable name use of get_cursor outside persistence)
implemented_structural_guardrails.enforcement_scope: no service or route may import get_cursor directly; they must use the public surface of the persistence layer.

implemented_structural_guardrails.name: repository.py has the single-transaction pattern
implemented_structural_guardrails.enforcement_scope: repository.py must use the single-transaction pattern (3 tests).

implemented_structural_guardrails.name: services use public surface of repository only
implemented_structural_guardrails.enforcement_scope: services must use the public surface of the repository only; no private attribute or function access.

deferred_guardrails.name: route no-refattening
deferred_guardrails.reason: sensitive to inline comments, blank lines, and docstring counting; would be brittle

deferred_guardrails.name: service-count / no-new-service-without-justification
deferred_guardrails.reason: count-only check is brittle; justification check is too opinionated

deferred_guardrails.name: UI context key contract
deferred_guardrails.reason: context surface is large; key names not documented in a single place

deferred_guardrails.name: docs no-go scanner
deferred_guardrails.reason: docs surface is large; regex-based scanner would have high false-positive risk
deferred_guardrails.external_review_relevance: high (a docs no-go scanner would help the B-track governance review process; the tracker is the manual process that fills that gap until the scanner is implemented)

future_governance_guardrails_not_impleme.name: route-thinness guardrail
future_governance_guardrails_not_impleme.rationale: post-51 lesson; not implemented in this branch.

future_governance_guardrails_not_impleme.name: service-count guardrail
future_governance_guardrails_not_impleme.rationale: post-51 lesson; not implemented in this branch.

hard_stop_linkage.any_G1_G6_broken: PR is blocked per B25 hard-stop conditions.

global_notes: Agent B does not implement guardrails. Agent A implements guardrails.
Agent B does not modify app/persistence, app/services, main_web.py, or any Agent A-owned file. The guardrail adoption tracker is the B-track governance wrapper for the Agent A guardrail work.
The 6 implemented structural guardrails (G1-G6) and the 4 deferred guardrails (D1-D4) are sourced from the Phase 52F report.
The 21 -> 31 behavior guardrail test count change is the project's internal self-assessment. The change is verified by the Phase 52F report.
All 6 implemented structural guardrails (G1-G6) are required before Phase 53. The Phase 53 PRs must continue to satisfy the 6 guardrails.
D3 (UI context key contract) is the only Phase 54 guardrail. D1, D2, D4 are not required before Phase 54.
Route-thinness and service-count guardrails are post-51 lessons, not implemented as a part of B27. The D1 and D2 deferred guardrails track similar concerns.
Claude review / post-51T review are separate workstreams. They are referenced only as review evidence, not external validation or certification.
